<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has identified a time that works for all four partners: Thursday, November 19, from 14:30 to 15:00. My task is now to book this time in the firm's booking system.

I will use the `create_booking` function with the day "Thu" and start time "14:30".

Once the booking is created, I need to let Brad know so he can send the confirmation email, which is the final step in our task. I'll post a message to the shared workspace to confirm that the booking has been made.

This will complete all the required steps for our task. I'll use my first action to create the booking, my second to inform Brad, and then I will end my session.
